outcome.technical: _deps.COMMENT_SYNTAXES gains rows for .css (block comments only), .yml/.yaml/.toml (a `#` after whitespace, via a shared _HASH_COMMENT row), and .html (`<!-- -->` only, no quote opens a string). The shell-only key hash_word is replaced by three general keys - line_after, quote_after, raw_quote - read through a new _opens_here(); line may be None. Every row carries a `why`, which rc16d requires non-empty. Shell and JS behaviour unchanged (rc16b still passes). New case rc16d in test__deps.py: a fixture tree whose css, yml, yaml, toml and html files carry an id inside a comment AND outside one (a css content string, a quoted and a plain yml value, an apostrophe mid-word, a `#` in a URL, a toml string, page text). Only the comment hits are reported. The real tree has no hit in those kinds. The widened lint found 34 citations: 11 in .github/workflows/ci.yml and 23 across 16 CSS parts. Each id was removed, or replaced where the sentence needed it ('pre-F28' -> 'old'; 'is F87' -> 'is a claim about interpreters nobody measured'; 'honest before F280' -> 'honest before the gate refused to grade a tree it rewrote'; 'which is F21, and the third time...' -> 'so a mention spelled in the grammar would read as a claim'; 'It also carries F53' -> 'It also drives the hooks no step wired'). Comments only, no CSS rule touched. register_citation_violations() over the tree now returns []. Re-rendered with `sh examples/report.sh` (acme-store html+md, docs/index.html; the md diff is the render timestamp only) and with check-rendered-artifacts' recipe for docs/demo-large.html; `check-rendered-artifacts.py --before-commit` exit 0. UI pins: count-ui-pins.py exit 0. No pin in plugins/audit/tests asserts on any changed comment text, and the only comment-anchored slice (`/* composition: filter toolbar`) is untouched. Full sweep exit 1, cp1252 sweep exit 1: in both the only red is test__refs.py sc1/sc2, because the screenshot source digest moved. All 25 docs/screenshots/*.png are stale per _refs.screenshot_capture_drift(), and that check returns 0 on a git-archive HEAD export, so the comment edits caused it. Capture was withheld as instructed. gate-parity exit 0. ruff and vermin are clean on both .py files. Left as is: .github/workflows/ci.yml:134 (a step `name:`) and :205 (an `echo`) still carry F117. They are YAML values and shell output, not comments, so the lint does not read them. Renaming them is a separate decision. docs/handbook.html's one fault-shaped hit is inside SVG data. Not decided here: .tape, .gitignore and .gitattributes, which have `#` comments and no citation today (measured with _fault_hits). A per-kind coverage gate was not added, because the disk walk sees local strays (the main checkout holds 14 extensionless files and a .TAG), so it would go red on machine state.
outcome.descriptive: The comment-citation lint now reads CSS, YAML, TOML and HTML comments, and the 34 register citations it found in CI and stylesheet comments are now plain constraints.
